title: Scattering for the KP-II equation
summary: We prove scattering in $L^2(\mathbb{R}^2)$ for real-valued solutions of the Kadomtsev--Petviashvili II (KP-II) equation with localized initial data. No smallness assumption is made, no zero mean condition is imposed, and the admissible data include all Schwartz functions. The proof uses the inverse scattering transform attached to the heat operator.
